name: Octree Frustum Culling & LOD Selection
definition: Recursively traverses an octree to cull chunks outside the camera frustum and select appropriate LOD levels based on distance to the camera.
summary: Octree Frustum Culling & LOD Selection recursively traverses an octree to combine visibility culling and distance-based LOD assignment into a single pass, deferring geometry queueing until a node is fully visible or outside the frustum.
